predicted.headline: Predicted, not announced. Every name below is the vendor's model output, not a team sheet.

confirmed.headline: Confirmed team sheet. These are the names as submitted.

served-empty.headline: The vendor answered with an empty sheet. Something was served and it contained no players — which is not the same as nothing being announced.

not-in-payload.headline: The response carried no lineups at all. The question was not answered, and it was not refused either.

explicitly-null.headline: The vendor named the lineups field and left it empty. That is a stated absence, not a missing response.

kind-not-stated.headline: Players were served and the vendor did not say whether this is announced or predicted. It is not safe to read as either.

kind-unrecognised.headline: Players were served under a status this page has never seen: "probable". Treated as neither announced nor predicted.

not-requested.headline: No request was made, so nothing is known about any lineup. This is not an empty team sheet and not a failed call.
